monthly_rent.line: The Tenant shall pay monthly rent of ₹25,000 (Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand only)

security_deposit.line: On signing, the Tenant shall pay an interest-free refundable security deposit of ₹75,000, equal to three months of the monthly rent.

total_length.line: The tenancy begins on 1 October 2026 and ends on 30 September 2027, a fixed term of twelve months

tenant_notice.line: Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving sixty days’ written notice.

landlord_notice.line: Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving sixty days’ written notice.

tenant_can_leave_early.line: The Tenant may leave before the fixed term ends by giving the same notice and paying rent through the notice period

landlord_can_end_early.line: Either Party may terminate this Agreement by giving sixty days’ written notice.

rent_increase.line: If the Parties renew the tenancy for a further term, the monthly rent will increase by five percent from the first day of the renewed term

maintenance.line: Monthly building maintenance of ₹2,000 shall be paid by the Landlord.

deposit_refund_time.line: Within fifteen calendar days after the Tenant returns vacant possession and all keys, the Landlord shall refund the balance of the deposit.

auto_renewal.line: Any extension must be recorded in a written document signed by both Parties; continued discussions alone do not create a renewal.
